verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Teams channels exist and can be created/configured via Graph API (ms-teams-docs-8, ms-teams-docs-35, ms-teams-docs-43), implying channel-based organization, but nothing explicitly documents public vs. private channel types or membership/access controls for admins. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of public/private channel distinction, membership management APIs or admin UI, and any independent confirmation of these controls working as described.
